budget_items.topic: FY27 Total revenues and available appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager presented FY27 revenue projections showing total revenues and available funds for appropriation.
budget_items.quote: total revenues were projected at $51,004,918.00. after subtracting non-appropriated expenses and state assessments, and holding the same levy amount appropriated to the capital plan as in the prior year, available funds for appropriation were estimated at $49,805,800.

budget_items.topic: New FY27 revenue compared to prior year
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Approximately $1,429,364 in new FY27 revenue was identified, an increase of roughly $100,000 from figures presented two weeks prior.
budget_items.quote: this yielded approximately $1,429,364 in new fy27 revenue - an increase of roughly $100,000 from figures presented two weeks prior.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager presented proportional distribution scenario showing schools would receive 53.3% of new revenue, town 43.9%, and Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School 2.76%.
budget_items.quote: schools (53.3%) would receive approximately $762,280; the town (43.9%) approximately $627,634; and montachusett regional vocational technical school (2.76%) approximately $39,450.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School assessment was noted to have increased 8.8%, substantially exceeding its proportional share.
budget_items.quote: last year it represented an 8.8% increase, or approximately $117,438, which would substantially exceed its proportional share.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health insurance costs previously projected at 20% revised to average of 8.3% with high of 14.4% due to removal of GLP-one drugs from coverage.
budget_items.quote: health insurance: previously projected at 20%, now revised to an average of 8.3% (trust average) with a high of 14.4%, due to the removal of glp-one drugs from coverage

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Retirement costs identified as a non-negotiable 10% increase.
Fourth shift fire department costs identified as major budget driver.
After subtracting four major budget drivers from new revenue, Town Manager projected a deficit.
budget_items.quote: after subtracting these four items from the $1,429,364 in new revenue, the town manager projected a deficit of approximately negative $615,000.

budget_items.topic: Total FY27 deficit from all budget requests
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Full FY27 deficit based on all budget requests received to date, not accounting for utilities, vendor contracts, TCP costs, pavement management, Monty Tech actual assessment, or other increases.
budget_items.quote: the full fy27 deficit, based on all budget requests received to date, is slightly north of $3,000,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Committee Member Lockwood cited recycling program growth from approximately $150,000 at start of COVID to over $500,000 as area for internal efficiency review.
budget_items.quote: the town's recycling program, which she noted had grown from approximately $150,000 at the start of covid to over $500,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: School choice enrollment revenue declined from approximately $500,000 to $112,000 on cherry sheet, identified as area to review.
budget_items.quote: school choice enrollment revenue, which has declined from approximately $500,000 to $112,000 on the cherry sheet.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager raised possibility of eliminating mosquito control program assessment.
budget_items.quote: the possibility of eliminating the mosquito control program assessment (approximately $100,000)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Committee Member Lockwood noted that a $3,000,000 override would translate to approximately $600 per year in additional taxes on average homeowner.
budget_items.quote: a $3,000,000 override would translate to approximately $600 per year in additional taxes
